commit.subject: LU-20789 tests: sanity/276 do proper cleanup
commit.message:
LU-20789 tests: sanity/276 do proper cleanup

test 276 in sanity should ensure ost1's recovery is completed,
otherwise subsequent tests (like 300d) may hit different issues
due to missing ost1.

add explicit check-wait in 300d to ensure all OSPs are healthy
and can provide objects immediately.
